tests.scope: Latest observed results for eight main Vitest shards: seven retained attempt1 executions plus Windows shard4 rerun in attempt2. Ubuntu/Windows platform occurrences, not unique cases. Broker/Electron/node stages excluded.

failure.classification: Observed SSE event-wait timeout; root/peer diagnosis pending. Not yet classified as flaky or product regression.

failure.aggregateFailureQualification: Final CI job fails because one required test shard failed; not a second independent product-test failure.

retryQualification: Root requested one targeted diagnostic retry of Windows shard4 and dependent CI aggregator. GitHub clones retained jobs into new API IDs/run_attempt2 while preserving original execution timestamps and steps; executionJobId/executionAttempt preserve true provenance. A passing retry does not prove the original SSE timeout root cause or a source fix.
nativeArtifactQualification: Provider-reported compressed archive metadata retained; this monitor downloaded no native packages. Separate worker owns actual native audit.
limits: This monitor performed no rerun, cancellation, source edit, native package download or production action. Root invoked the one targeted retry recorded in retryIntent.
Attempt1 failed receipt/raw bytes remain immutable and separate. Earlier excluded parser draft remains excluded.
CI results alone do not prove persisted two-client, real-recipient email, Mac hardware or signed updater acceptance.
Source/tag is unchanged; publication remains a separate root decision after all gates.

importProvenance.qualification: Canonical CI schema and all result/attempt/execution qualifiers come from the sealed retry receipt. Only indexed evidence paths are rebound to this delivery packet; both original receipts are imported byte-identically. Original attempt2 ../monitor-038 references resolve through the manifest to ci-attempt1.
